meta.name: init-deep
meta.description: Initializes a hierarchical AGENTS.md knowledge base for a project. Use when a repo needs its structure, commands, and conventions documented for agents.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为仓库生成分层的 AGENTS.md 文档,把目录结构、常用命令与编码约定写清楚
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常接手陌生代码库,想让 AI 助手一进项目就摸清结构。
copy.tagline_en: Write layered AGENTS.md so AI assistants learn a repo's structure and commands.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often pick up unfamiliar repos and want AI to know them fast.

howto.what: 装上后运行 /init-deep,它会扫描仓库,在根目录和评分较高的子目录里生成分层的 AGENTS.md 文件,写明结构、命令与约定,并按评分决定哪些目录值得单独建文件。
howto.when: 当仓库需要把结构、命令和约定记录成 AGENTS.md 给 agent 用时,或你直接运行 /init-deep 时接管;默认目录深度 3 层。

say.text: /init-deep 给这个仓库建一套分层 AGENTS.md
say.note: 更新已有文件,并按需新建

say.text: /init-deep --create-new 先读现有的再全部重生成
say.note: 读取旧内容后删除并重新生成
限制生成文件的目录层级

howto.what_en: Running /init-deep scans the repo and generates hierarchical AGENTS.md files at the root and in higher-scored subdirectories, covering structure, commands and conventions, with scoring deciding which directories get their own file.
howto.when_en: Use it when a repo needs its structure, commands and conventions documented as AGENTS.md for agents, or when you run /init-deep yourself; default directory depth is 3.

say_en.text: /init-deep build a hierarchical AGENTS.md set for this repo
say_en.note: Updates existing files and creates new ones as needed

say_en.text: /init-deep --create-new read existing files, then regenerate everything
say_en.note: Reads old content, deletes it, then regenerates

say_en.text: /init-deep --max-depth=2 limit directory depth to two levels
say_en.note: Caps how deep files are generated
